removed.name: a11yCheckoutStepsLandmarks
removed.description: `Checkout` add a landmarks to content representing steps

removed.name: a11yItemCounterFocus
removed.description:
In `ItemCounterComponenet`, Remove button no longer lose focus after activating when count is 2.
Add button no longer lose focus after activating when count is `max - 1`.

removed.name: a11yPasswordVisibliltyBtnValueOverflow
removed.description: Stops the inputs value from obstructing the 'PasswordVisibilityToggleComponent'.

removed.name: a11yPickupOptionsTabs
removed.description:
Use tabs instead of radio group for pickup options. Improves SR narration and keyboard navigation pattern.
Modified components:
 - `PickupOptionsComponent`
 - `PdpPickupOptionsContainerComponent`
 - `CartPickupOptionsContainerComponent`
 - `AddToCartComponent`

removed.name: a11yScrollToReviewByShowReview
removed.description: `ProductIntroComponent` should now scroll to the Review tab on the first click of the 'Show Review' button.

removed.name: a11ySearchboxLabel
removed.description: Adds label to the `SearchBoxComponent` search input

removed.name: a11yUpdatingCartNoNarration
removed.description: In `AddedToCartDialogComponent`, `Updating cart...` should no longer read by a screen reader.

removed.name: a11yViewHoursButtonIconContrast
removed.description:
`StoreComponent and MyPreferredStoreComponent` an icon in a button that triggers showing
store's opening hours has an acceptable contrast ratio in a default theme

removed.name: headerLayoutForSmallerViewports
removed.description:
`StorefrontComponent`: Prevents header links from wrapping on smaller screen sizes.
Enables support for increased letter-spacing up to 0.12em for header layout

removed.name: trendingSearches
removed.description: In `SearchBoxComponent` it shows the trending searches.

removed.name: useExtendedMediaComponentConfiguration
removed.description: When enabled, allows to provide extended formats and media queries for element if used in MediaComponent. Important: After activation default HTML element in MediaComponent will be `` Only BannerComponent has passed `'picture'` value. If you need to use `` HTML element you need to pass `[elementType]="'picture'"` to `` For proper work requires `pictureElementFormats` provided in media config: ```ts provideConfig({ pictureElementFormats: { mediaQueries: '(max-width: 480px)', }, }) ``` Toggle activates `@Input() elementType: 'img' | 'picture' = 'img'` and `@Input() sizesForImgElement: string` in `MediaComponent`

added.name: enableQuotePurchaseOrderNumber
added.description:
shows the Quote Purchase Order Number input field in the Quote Request form
and in the Quote Details page

when set to `true`, the user will be able to enter a Purchase Order Number
when requesting a quote and see it in the quote details

added.name: enableReturnOrderReturnableQuantityConsigmentFallback
added.description:
When enabled, fixes the issue with return order returnable quantity not being displayed correctly
on the `ReturnOrderComponent` when navigating to the return request details page.

added.name: navigationMenuCloseOnSameLinkClick
added.description:
When this feature toggle is enabled, the navigation menu will close when clicking on the same link.

This is to improve the user experience on mobile devices, where the menu remains open
after clicking on a link that navigates to the same page.

defaultEnabled.name: a11yImprovedErrorMessage
defaultEnabled.description:
`FormErrorsComponent` replace role="alert" to aria-live="polite" as default
 together with aria-live="atomic"

defaultEnabled.name: a11yNgSelectLayering
defaultEnabled.description:
Fixes layering issues caused by native ng-select styles.
Sets the dropdown's z-index property to be more in line with Spartacus.

defaultEnabled.name: a11yOptimizedMenuSpacing
defaultEnabled.description:
Adjusts line spacing in menus and navigation dropdowns for better readability
across different monitors, text sizes, and zoom levels.

defaultEnabled.name: a11yWideScreenImprovements
defaultEnabled.description:
Improves wide viewport layout issues.
Affects the styles of: Order confirmation page, product configurator.

defaultEnabled.name: opfEnablePreventingFromCheckoutWithoutEmail
defaultEnabled.description:
When enabled, checks before accessing checkout
if user has email assigned to the current cart.
If not - redirects user to `/opf-checkout-email` page.
After providing email user will be redirected back to checkout.
